portals.observation: Official interactive map lists a “Matrice graphique” theme with civic number, lot, cadastre and assessment information; city Experience Builder is public.

Anonymous public Experience config advertises CI_MatriceGraphique_DEV FeatureServer layers 3,4,8,10,17,18,20,29,34,35. Direct selected layer metadata/query returned ArcGIS JSON error 499 Token Required. No auth/token acquired; no feature geometry retained.
Official provincial cadastre is the authoritative public cadastral custodian; city’s matrix viewer integrates lot/cadastre layer.
Search-indexed Lot polygon layer. Standard direct metadata and exact WUP geometry-only request were each HTTP 200 but returned 246-byte HTML edge rejection, not JSON geometry.
